##### Project general facts

Sole Mio Residences is a truly exceptional premium apartment complex nestled just 150 metres from the pristine shores of Bang Tao Beach in Phuket, Thailand. This award-winning, yacht-inspired development comprises two elegantly designed buildings — Building A with 4 floors and Building B with 7 floors — offering an exclusive collection of only 61 residences. Available in a stunning variety of layouts ranging from Studios and Suites to Deluxe apartments and Duplexes, each home is thoughtfully crafted to deliver the ultimate in private, resort-style living.

Residents of Sole Mio enjoy an extraordinary array of world-class amenities that elevate everyday life to a five-star experience. The centrepiece is the breathtaking exclusive rooftop club, featuring an infinity pool with panoramic sea views and dedicated beach services. A state-of-the-art premium fitness centre with pro-grade equipment offers panoramic tropical views, while the on-site Wellness Longevity Clinic — offering 50+ programmes focused on beauty, health, and longevity — sets this development apart as a truly unique haven of well-being. Residents also benefit from a serene spa and wellness centre, a spacious sun-drenched library, and an on-site seaside restaurant with gourmet room delivery service, along with a prestigious 5-year Banyan Tree Golf Club membership and Thailand Elite visa privileges.

Every apartment at Sole Mio Residences is finished to the most exacting standards, reflecting a refined aesthetic inspired by luxury yacht design. Interiors feature soaring double-height ceilings in the Duplex units, bespoke integrated cabinetry, and premium stone and natural wood finishes throughout. Kitchens are equipped with top-grade fitted appliances and generous island countertops, while master bedrooms are serene sanctuaries with floor-to-ceiling glazing and elegant en-suite bathrooms. Every detail — from the curvaceous architectural shelving to the soft ambient lighting systems — has been meticulously selected to create homes that are as beautiful as they are liveable.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Choeng Thale stands as one of Phuket’s most prestigious and sophisticated coastal destinations, blending tropical tranquility with modern luxury living. Nestled along the island’s sought-after western shoreline, the area is renowned for its upscale residential communities, stylish resorts, and breathtaking natural surroundings. With its pristine beaches, elegant architecture, and relaxed yet vibrant atmosphere, Choeng Thale offers an exceptional lifestyle that reflects the refined charm of Phuket’s premium seaside living.

Choeng Thale is far more than a residential area — it is a destination centered around leisure, wellness, and recreation. The community features world-class beach clubs, luxury spas, fitness centers, golf courses, and scenic parks that create an ideal environment for relaxation and active living. Residents and visitors can enjoy easy access to stunning beaches such as Bang Tao and Surin, where crystal-clear waters and white sandy shores provide the perfect setting for coastal enjoyment.

The dynamic lifestyle of Choeng Thale is enriched by its impressive selection of retail, dining, and entertainment venues. Trendy cafes, fine dining restaurants, boutique shopping centers, and vibrant lifestyle hubs are seamlessly integrated throughout the area, ensuring everyday convenience alongside a cosmopolitan atmosphere. Additionally, Choeng Thale benefits from excellent connectivity to Phuket International Airport and other key destinations across the island, making it a highly desirable location for both permanent residence and holiday living.
